product.title: Astro-Photo, Hiking and Stargazing Tour in Arches National Park

description.text: Arches National Park is spectacular at night—but photographing its star-lit scenery takes special equipment and skills. By providing tripods, expert tips, and red LED headlamps, this small-group tour helps you capture the night sky through astrophotography. Stops include Arches National Park. And since few visitors venture into the park at night, you'll also experience the landscape at its most serene, minus the daytime crowds.Arches National Park night-time tour features astrophotography Use provided equipment to photograph the stars Enjoy cool evening temperatures and zero crowds Convenient meet-up point is close to trails Ideal for travelers basing in Moab who want a guided Utah adventure without self-driving backcountry roads or river put-ins.
